details.name: A3 naive retry creates duplicate side effect
B1 keyed first response is transport-unknown
B2 only one effect exists after same-key retry
B3 retry returns original effect identity
B4 replay is explicitly detectable in harness
C2 fresh retry key duplicates original intent
D2 same key different payload rejected

scenarios_summary.naive_unknown_retry: response lost after e1 commit; naive retry created e2
scenarios_summary.stable_key_retry: response lost after e1 commit; same-key retry returned e1; one effect
scenarios_summary.fresh_key_retry_bug: new key on retry created duplicate e2
scenarios_summary.payload_mismatch: same key with different payload rejected 422; one effect
scenarios_summary.concurrent_duplicate: same-key concurrent request rejected 409; later retry replayed e1

notes: Idempotency-Key draft-07 is expired work-in-progress, not an RFC.
Harness uses its key/fingerprint/replay/conflict pattern as bounded practice, not a standards-conformance claim.
